baseline_adaptation: Fixed path uses existing literal preparationQuery plus BM25, then one structured synthesis. All arms receive the same goal and constraints; the single prompt gets the entire allowed small corpus.
business_writes: No writes in CLI arms; SQL confirmation, ownership, stale input and idempotency are separately tested
cost: Reported usage and optional user-supplied prices; absent usage or prices leaves cost null. Controlled responses are not actual token/cost measurements.
